name: B10-0176/2025 (PfE) – Democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on democracy and human rights in Thailand, notably the lese-majesty law and the deportation of Uyghur refugees
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking the European Union and its member states to act. It condemns Thailand for sending at least 40 Uyghurs back to China, where it says they face persecution and torture. It also criticises Thailand's lese-majesty law, which jails people for insulting the king, as a limit on free speech. It asks the EU to raise these concerns with Thailand and China.

- No law changes; Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- It affects the deported Uyghurs, people charged under Thailand's lese-majesty law, and EU talks with Thailand and China.
- Next, the EU and member states are asked to raise these cases with the Thai and Chinese authorities.
